INTERACTIVE STOPS — TEST BUILD 1.2.0-alpha.1

Visit diners and handle flat tires through a sequence of choices. Tools and your career matter. Prices and game-time costs are shown before you act; reading takes no game time. Conversation text is always readable, with optional diner ambience and nonverbal voices. Stops save with your journey, and an untouched local copy of your pre-expansion journey is retained.

PRIVACY

Progress, records, encounter choices and settings stay in this app's local storage. Encounter history belongs to the current journey; this test build does not infer a real-world personality or implement cross-run meta narration
